scenario.title: Rainy Day at the Farmers Market
scenario.context: A rainy Saturday morning at the local farmers market
scenario.description: Nina, a cheesemaker, and her best friend, Raj, who is a baker, have stalls next to each other at the local farmers market. It has been raining heavily and market footfall is significantly low. Raj is feeling down due to the low sales. Nina notices his low spirits and tries to uplift him.
scenario.speaker2_persona_1: High EQ - Optimistic, understanding, calm, expressive
scenario.speaker2_persona_high: High EQ - Optimistic, understanding, calm, expressive

conversation.speaker: speaker1
conversation.text: Raj, you seem a bit off today. Is it because of the weather dampening our sales?

conversation.speaker: speaker2
conversation.text: Yeah, Nina. This rain has really put a damper on things. Barely sold any bread today.

conversation.speaker: speaker1
conversation.text: I know it's disheartening, but remember how we bounced back last time it rained? We even had a rush for your sourdough!

conversation.speaker: speaker2
conversation.text: You're right, Nina. I suppose it's just hard not to feel down when you're staring at all these unsold loaves.

conversation.speaker: speaker1
conversation.text: I get it, Raj. But hey, let's make the best of it. How about some bread and cheese for lunch?

conversation.speaker: speaker2
conversation.text: That sounds like a plan, Nina. Let's turn this rainy day into a picnic!
